blocks.text: Software development tools woh programs ya applications hain jo software banane ki mukhtalif stages mein madad karte hain. Yeh code likhne, edit karne, test karne, debug karne aur sambhalne ke liye istemal hote hain, ta ke software theek aur efficiently kaam kare.

blocks.prompt: Software development tools kin paanch kaamon mein madad karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Code likhna (write), badalna (edit), test karna, debug karna aur sambhalna (manage).

items: Development tools: code likhne, edit, test, debug aur manage karne wale programs.
